item.title: Integrated Care and Public Health
item.content:encoded:
This call seeks contributions addressing the intersection of integrated care approaches and public health practice and policy. The special issue welcomes research exploring how integrated care models can be implemented, evaluated, and scaled within public health contexts.

Appel publié par Public Health. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
